title: Telemetry and disposable database tests
summary: Node/Python OpenTelemetry wrappers with real span/redaction tests, plus explicit Collector and PostgreSQL Testcontainers profiles for transaction and rollback acceptance.

profiles: Linux x86_64, Node 24.19.0 / OpenTelemetry SDK 0.223.0: 2 real SDK span/correlation/attribute-filter tests passed using an in-memory exporter and explicit deterministic sampler.
Linux x86_64, Python 3.12.14 / OpenTelemetry SDK 1.45.1: 1 real SDK context/attribute/exception test passed using an in-memory exporter and deterministic sampler.
notes: Docker, Collector validation and real PostgreSQL/Testcontainers execution were unavailable and remain unexecuted. Explicit container gates fail without a daemon instead of skipping.
For Docker: npm run test:containers; for Python provision python/requirements-containers.txt then python -m pytest python/test_containers.py. Collector commands are in CONTRACT.md.
Default official PostgreSQL image is postgres:18.6-alpine3.24; receiving CI may select an approved immutable digest. No production database URL is accepted by these fixture tests.
Telemetry tests prove wrapper behavior only. The host reviews trusted exporters, production sampling, allowed attribute values, instrumentation additions and backend retention.
